nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the current contract owner, set to msg.sender in the constructor and updated in acceptOwnership.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address written by transferOwnership and cleared by acceptOwnership.
GLOBALTRUSTFUND.balances: mapping(address => uint) token balances, credited in the constructor and mutated by transfer/transferFrom.
GLOBALTRUSTFUND.allowed: nested allowance mapping written by approve/approveAndCall and decremented by transferFrom.
GLOBALTRUSTFUND._totalSupply: total token supply set to 30000000000000000 in the constructor.
Public token symbol string set to 'GTF' in the constructor.
Public token name string set to 'GLOBALTRUSTFUND TOKEN' in the constructor.
Public token decimals set to 8 in the constructor.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): checked addition requiring c >= a, returns the sum.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): checked subtraction requiring b <= a, returns the difference.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): checked multiplication requiring a == 0 || c / a == b.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): checked division requiring b > 0.
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged role.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner; two-step ownership transfer.
Function callable by the pending newOwner that promotes newOwner to owner and clears the pending slot.
GLOBALTRUSTFUND constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals, mints the whole supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] (burned tokens).
Returns the token balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens with no double-spend guard and emits Approval.
Spends allowance and moves balances from 'from' to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd; emits Transfer.
Returns the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
Sets the allowance then invokes approveAndCall's spender contract via receiveApproval, forwarding msg.sender, tokens, this and arbitrary data.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner function that performs an external ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) call to an arbitrary token address.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as owner, allowance owner, balance owner and onlyOwner gate.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) executed inside approveAndCall with attacker-chosen callee and data.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) executed in transferAnyERC20Token against an arbitrary, owner-supplied token address.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner from msg.sender, establishing the privileged role that gates onlyOwner functions.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into newOwner, gated by onlyOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
Constructor mints the total supply into _totalSupply.
Constructor credits the full supply to the fixed deployer address in balances.
Constructor sets the symbol state variable.
Constructor sets the name state variable.
Constructor sets the decimals state variable.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply and subtracts the address(0) balance.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the supplied owner.
transfer mutates balances[msg.sender] and balances[to].
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping with no double-spend protection.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping of from and to.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] via safeSub.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
transfer uses msg.sender as the source of funds and balance key.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
approveAndCall keys the allowance and callback arguments on msg.sender.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, an access-control gate on an untrusted caller.
Owned constructor takes the owner role directly from the untrusted msg.sender.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by onlyOwner, gating msg.sender against the stored owner.
transfer delegates balance subtraction to safeSub to prevent underflow.
transfer delegates balance addition to safeAdd to prevent overflow.
transferFrom uses safeSub for both the balance and the allowance deduction.
transferFrom uses safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
approveAndCall performs an external callback into the caller-supplied spender contract via receiveApproval.
The reentrant receiveApproval callback can re-enter approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom while the allowance state is live.
transferAnyERC20Token makes an external call into an arbitrary attacker-supplied token contract.
The external token transfer is directed to the owner address, making the privileged sink reachable through an attacker-chosen contract.
transferAnyERC20Token reads owner as the destination of the withdrawn tokens.
Parameter a flows into the safeAdd computation.
Parameter b flows into the safeAdd computation.
Parameter a flows into the safeSub computation.
Parameter b flows into the safeSub computation.
Parameter a flows into the safeMul computation.
Parameter b flows into the safeMul computation.
Parameter a flows into the safeDiv computation.
Parameter b flows into the safeDiv computation.
Parameter _newOwner is stored as the pending owner by transferOwnership.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
Parameter to is the credited account in transfer.
Parameter tokens determines the debited/credited amount in transfer.
Parameter spender indexes the allowance mapping in approve.
Parameter tokens is written into the allowance in approve.
Parameter from is the debited account and allowance owner in transferFrom.
Parameter to is the credited account in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens determines the debited/credited amount in transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the allowance mapping in allowance.
Parameter spender indexes the allowance mapping in allowance.
Parameter spender is the allowance key and the target address in approveAndCall.
Parameter tokens is written to the allowance and forwarded to the callback.
Parameter data is forwarded to the external callback in approveAndCall.
Attacker-controlled spender determines which contract is invoked by the receiveApproval external call.
Arbitrary attacker-supplied data is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
Parameter tokenAddress is cast to ERC20Interface for the external call.
Parameter tokens is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer.
Attacker/owner-supplied tokenAddress controls the callee of the external ERC20 transfer call.
